caption:
Everyone who’s ate breakfast should hear this 

#usahealth #wellness #usa #newyork #american
transcript: Everyone who ate breakfast this morning should hear this. In Chinese medicine, the body was never designed to digest all day long. Our ancestors did not eat by habit or by the clock. They ate by rhythm, by season, and by true hunger. The stomach and spleen are seen as the body's inner fire. When food keeps coming without rest, this fire weakens. When there is space, the fire grows strong again. Ask yourself this. Why does the body heal most deeply during sleep? Because you are fasted, energy is no longer pulled toward digestion. Qi returns inward to repair, cleanse, and restore balance. This is an ancient principle. When digestion rests, healing begins. Modern culture teaches constant eating. Traditional wisdom teaches pauses. Gentle fasting, when done with awareness, may allow the body to reduce internal stress, support renewal, redirect energy toward healing, not through force, not through extremes, but through listening. Health is not created by more intake. It is created by balance. Eat with intention. Leave space between meals. Let the body remember what it already knows. If this message resonates with you, you can explore these teachings deeper in my e-book, available in the link on my profile.
